NONE: C1 likely to change often
多變的；反復無常的
C1 a number, amount, or situation that can change
變數

example: a variable interest rate
不斷變化的利率
British weather is perhaps at its most variable in the spring.
在英國，春季的天氣可能是最變幻莫測的。
The variables in the equation are X, Y, and Z.
方程式中的變數是X，Y 和 Z。
The data was analysed according to neighbourhoods, but other key variables like credit rating and marital status were ignored altogether.
對這些資料按照所在街區進行了分析，但像信用等級、婚姻狀況等其他關鍵變數則一概忽略不計。

C or U: › [ C or U ] formal the fact that two or more things are different, or the amount or number by which they are different
C: › [ C ] US specialized law official permission to do something that is not normally allowed
› to be in disagreement with someone or something, or to be different from him, her, or it

example: There has been some unusual variance in temperature this month.
本月氣溫有些異常變化。
I could detect subtle variances in fragrance as we strolled through the garden.
我們在花園散步時，我可以聞出不同香味間的細微差異。
We had to get a (zoning) variance before we could build the extension on our house.
我們擴建房屋前必須獲得（城市規劃）特殊許可。
Young people's reactions to world events are often at variance with those of their parents.
年輕人對國際大事的反應往往與父輩們存在差異。
Her public and private personas are at variance.
她在公眾和私下表現出的人格面貌並不一致。

NONE: › something that is slightly different from other similar things
變體；變種；變形
› different
不同的；有差別的；變異的

example: There are many colas on the market now, all variants on the original drink.
現在市場上有多種可樂，都跟最初的差別不大。
There are four variants of malaria, all transmitted to humans by a particular family of mosquitoes.
瘧疾有四個變種，都是透過一種特殊的蚊子傳播給人。
a variant form
變體

C or U: B2 [ C or U ] a change in amount or level

C: C2 [ C ] something that is slightly different from the usual form or arrangement
變種，變體；變化了的東西
› [ C ] specialized music one of several short tunes that are based on the same simple tune, but are different from it and from the others

example: Unemployment rates among white-collar workers show much less regional variation than corresponding rates among blue-collar workers.
白領工作者的失業率與藍領工人相比，地區性差異要小得多。
The medical tests showed some variation in the baby's heart rate.
醫學檢驗顯示出嬰兒的心率有些不齊。
global temperature variations over the last 140 years
過去140年間全球氣溫的變化
There are wide variations in the way pensioners have benefited from the system.
養老金領取者從這個體制中受益的情況有很大差別。
The films she makes are all variations on the same theme.
她拍的電影圍繞的都是同一主題。
symphonic variations
交響樂變奏曲

NONE: › a swollen and often painful vein, especially in the legs
（尤指腿部的）靜脈曲張

example: Pregnant women often get varicose veins.
孕婦常患有靜脈曲張。

NONE: B2 containing or changing between several different things or types
各種各樣的；形形色色的

example: a varied group of people
形形色色的一群人
a lengthy and varied career
漫長而豐富多彩的職業生涯
With its varied climate, the country attracts both winter and summer sports enthusiasts.
該國氣候多變，吸引了冬季和夏季運動愛好者。

NONE: › having a pattern of different colours or marks
色彩斑駁的；有斑點的

example: a variegated plant
色彩斑駁的植物

NONE: › specialized food & drink a type of grape that is used to make wine, or a wine that is made from one type of grape
特定品種的釀酒葡萄；用特定品種的葡萄釀造的酒
› specialized biology, food & drink a particular type of a plant
特定品種的植物
› specialized food & drink relating to a type of grape or to wine made from one type of grape
特定品種釀酒葡萄的；用特定品種葡萄釀造的酒的
› specialized biology, food & drink relating to a variety or to different varieties of a plant
特定品種的植物的

example: Malbec, a red-wine varietal, represents a quarter of Argentina's wine exports.
瑪律貝克，一種紅葡萄酒，占阿根廷葡萄酒出口量的四分之一。
Customers can browse wines by price, varietal, region and year.
顧客可以根據葡萄酒的價格、葡萄種類、產地和年份來流覽。
Restaurant menus might specify a particular varietal of vegetable or mention the farm where it was grown.
餐館的菜單上可能會標明特定蔬菜的品種或者提及種植這些蔬菜的農場。
the unique varietal character of the grape
這種葡萄獨一無二的品種特徵

U: B1 [ U ] the characteristic of often changing and being different

C: › [ C ] a different type of something
S: A2 [ S ] many different types of things or people

U: › [ U ] a type of entertainment which includes several separate short performances, such as singing, dancing, magic tricks, and telling jokes

example: When planning meals, you need to think about variety and taste as well as nutritional value.
做飯時，你既需要考慮飯菜的營養價值，又需要考慮飯菜的花樣和味道。
Sexual reproduction serves to create genetic variety.
有性繁殖可以使基因多樣化。
Work on the production line is monotonous and lacks variety.
在生產線上工作很單調，缺乏變化。
The article was about the different varieties of Spanish spoken in South America.
這篇文章講的是南美洲西班牙語的各種變種。
This variety of rose is especially hardy and drought-resistant.
這種玫瑰特別耐寒及耐旱。
Our supermarket stocks apples in several different varieties.
我們超市有幾個不同品種的蘋果。
She does a variety of fitness activities.
她參加各種各樣的健身活動。
The equipment could be used for a variety of educational purposes.
這套設備可以用於多種教學活動。
Manufacturers need large sales to justify offering a big variety in export markets.
生產廠家需要極高的銷量來證明向出口市場提供種類繁多的產品是值得的。
a variety show
綜藝節目

NONE: › said to emphasize that doing many different things, or often changing what you do, makes life interesting
豐富多彩的經歷會令生活充滿樂趣。
› a shop that sells many different things, usually at low prices
雜貨店
A2 many different
各種不同的；各種各樣的

example: We had various problems on our journey, including a flat tyre.
我們在旅途中遇到了各種各樣的問題，包括輪胎被紮破了。
The author gave various reasons for having written the book.
作者給出了寫那本書的各種理由。
Girardo was out of action with various injuries for most of last season.
上個賽季大多數時間吉拉多都因為各種傷病而不能上場。
Various people whom we weren't expecting turned up at the meeting.
形形色色讓我們意想不到的人在會場出現了。

NONE: › many different
各種各樣的，許多不同的

example: He spent an hour telling me about various and sundry ideas he has for making money.
他花了一個小時的時間跟我講他的各種賺錢想法。

NONE: › in several different ways, at several different times, or by several different people
不同地；在不同時間；由不同的人

example: The law has been variously called "a noble experiment" and "one of the worst legislative mistakes in the country's history".
關於這條法律人們看法各不相同，有的稱其為「一項偉大的實驗」，有的稱其為「國家歷史上最糟糕的立法錯誤之一」。

NONE: › a liquid that is painted onto wood or paintings to protect the surface, or the hard shiny surface it produces when it dries
清漆；罩光漆；亮光漆
› to put varnish on a surface
為…上清漆
› UK to use nail varnish
塗指甲油

example: Polyurethane varnish provides a tough, scratch-resistant finish.
聚胺酯罩光漆可以形成一層堅硬防劃的表面。
a final coat of (clear) varnish
最後一層清漆
They decided to spend the weekend varnishing their boat.
他們決定用週末的時間給他們的船上清漆。

NONE: › covered with varnish
上過清漆的

example: a varnished surface
上過清漆的表面

NONE: › used to describe sports teams at schools or colleges that are at the most skilled level of play
大學體育代表隊的，校隊的
› a university
大學

example: He was a member of the varsity baseball team.
他是學校棒球隊的隊員。

I or T: B2 If things of the same type vary, they are different from each other, and if you vary them, you cause them to be different from each other.
B2 to change or cause something to change in amount or level, especially from one occasion to another

example: Salary scales vary between states/from state to state/according to state/with each state.
工資高低各州／州與州／不同的州／每個州都不同。
The samples varied in quality but were generally acceptable.
這些樣品品質有差異，但是大體上可以接受。
We have tried several different approaches, with varying degrees of success.
我們嘗試過不同的方法，成功率也不同。
My taste in classical music varies greatly/widely, but I usually prefer Mozart or Brahms.
我對各種古典音樂的喜好程度很不相同，但我通常比較喜歡莫札特或布拉姆斯的音樂。
Some people give a regular monthly donation while others vary the amount they give.
有些人每月捐贈固定數目的善款，而有些人每月捐贈的數額多少不一。
